# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 13 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 13:5 — cheeks like the fields of the Most High — poetic image

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "cheeks were like the fields of the Most High" | Literal agroi |
| LOGOS | "cheeks were like the fields of the Most High" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "cheeks were like the fertile fields of the Most High" | Adds 'fertile' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree. The Greek agroi simply means 'fields.' PNEUMA's 'fertile' is an interpretation; the image carries its own fertility connotation without the gloss. Adopted EMET/LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 13:5 — blood of a son of man — color simile

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "red like the blood of a son of man" | Literal haima huiou anthrōpou |
| LOGOS | "red like the blood of a son of man" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "flushed with red like the color of life" | Avoids blood imagery |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree on the literal 'blood of a son of man.' This is a specific and unusual simile in the Greek text and should be preserved. PNEUMA's avoidance of blood imagery softens the text inappropriately. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
